content: Workout logging spectrum: casual lifters log minimal data (workout completion, date, muscle groups) while dedicated apps (Hevy, Strong, SetGraph) center on per-exercise sets, reps and load with progression charts. Community consensus (Quantified Self forum, SetGraph): track only what answers what should I do better next time; friction of per-set entry is the main reason casual users abandon workout logging. Simple completion-style logs are a legitimate pattern, upgradeable later to detailed logging.
